title: Wipe worktops
steps: wash with warm water and washing-up liquid
use a food-safe disinfectant only if needed and as labelled
caution: Never mix cleaning chemicals.

title: Clean chopping boards
steps: Wash boards in hot soapy water after each use
sanitise as recommended for the board material
caution: Use separate boards for raw meat and ready-to-eat foods.

title: Degrease hob
steps: apply hob-safe cleaner to a cloth
caution: Avoid abrasive pads on glass or induction hobs.

title: Clean microwave
steps: Heat a microwave-safe bowl of water for a short period to soften splashes
wipe interior with a damp cloth
caution: Avoid burns from steam and hot water.

title: Freshen fridge shelves
steps: Move chilled food to a cool box if needed
wash with mild soapy water and dry
caution: Keep chilled foods cold; avoid prolonged time at room temperature.

title: Clean sink and taps
steps: dry taps to reduce water marks
caution: Use non-abrasive cleaner on plated fittings.

title: Wash reusable cloths
steps: wash cloths on a suitable hot laundry cycle according to label
caution: Use separate cloths for toilets and food areas.

title: Clean kettle exterior
caution: Never immerse electrical kettle in water.

title: Clean bin
steps: wash bin with warm soapy water
caution: Wash hands after handling waste.

title: Clean extractor filter
steps: rinse and dry fully before refitting
caution: Do not wash disposable charcoal filters unless manufacturer permits.

title: Clean bathroom sink
caution: Use cleaners compatible with natural stone and coatings.

title: Clean shower screen
caution: Avoid acidic cleaners on natural stone.

title: Clean toilet bowl
caution: Never mix bleach with toilet cleaner or acids.

title: Wipe toilet exterior
steps: Use separate bathroom cloth and suitable disinfectant
wipe flush handle lid seat and base
caution: Keep cloth separate from kitchen cleaning.

title: Remove shower hair
steps: remove trapped hair with a tool
caution: Do not combine chemical drain cleaners.

title: Clean bath
caution: Check acrylic baths for product compatibility.

title: Wash bath mats
caution: Avoid damp mats on slippery floors.

title: Clean bathroom mirror
steps: Spray glass cleaner onto cloth rather than directly onto edges
caution: Protect mirror backing from excess moisture.

title: Reduce bathroom mould
steps: Run extractor or open window during and after bathing
caution: For extensive mould or health concerns seek professional advice.

title: Clean grout gently
caution: Do not mix bleach and vinegar or other cleaners.

title: Sort washing
steps: Separate whites colours and delicate fabrics
caution: Keep stain products away from children.

title: Treat fresh stains
steps: test stain treatment on hidden area
caution: Never use hot water blindly on protein stains.

title: Clean washing machine seal
steps: Wipe accessible rubber seal folds with damp cloth
caution: Keep children and pets away from open machine.

title: Clean detergent drawer
caution: Unplug if manual requires maintenance isolation.

title: Clean lint filter
caution: Lint build-up is a fire hazard.

title: Dry clothes indoors safely
steps: keep away from heaters and open flames
caution: Avoid draping clothes over electric heaters.

title: Wash bedding
steps: wash sheets and pillowcases on suitable programme
caution: Do not overload washing machine.

title: Refresh towels
caution: Avoid excessive fabric conditioner if absorbency falls.

title: Clean iron soleplate
steps: wipe soleplate with soft damp cloth
caution: Never scrub hot soleplate.

title: Organise cleaning supplies
steps: store products upright in original containers
keep out of reach of children and pets
caution: Never decant chemicals into drink bottles.

title: Dust shelves
steps: dust from high to low using microfibre cloth
return objects after surfaces are clean
caution: Avoid standing on unstable furniture.

title: Vacuum carpets
steps: empty or replace vacuum bag as directed
caution: Use appropriate vacuum setting for delicate rugs.

title: Clean sofa fabric
caution: Do not soak upholstery.

title: Wipe light switches
steps: Apply mild cleaner to cloth not switch
caution: Do not allow liquid into electrical fittings.

title: Clean TV screen
steps: follow screen manufacturer's guidance for marks
caution: Do not spray cleaner directly on screen.

title: Clean window sills
caution: Inspect for condensation and leaks.

title: Vacuum skirting boards
steps: Use soft brush attachment to remove dust
caution: Test cleaner on painted finish first.

title: Clean door handles
caution: Observe disinfectant label contact time.

title: Freshen curtains
steps: launder or dry-clean only as instructed
caution: Heavy curtains may require specialist cleaning.

title: Clean remote controls
caution: Do not soak electronics.

title: Change bed linen
caution: Keep spare bedding in dry storage.

title: Vacuum mattress
steps: vacuum mattress surface with upholstery tool
caution: Do not wet memory foam unless approved.

title: Dust bedside tables
caution: Keep liquids away from chargers.

title: Organise wardrobe
steps: Remove items one shelf at a time
caution: Avoid overloading high shelves.

title: Clean under bed
caution: Do not move heavy furniture alone.

title: Mop hard floors
steps: dilute floor-safe cleaner according to label
mop with damp not soaking pad
caution: Use very little water on laminate and timber.

title: Clean internal windows
steps: use suitable glass cleaner and lint-free cloth
caution: Avoid leaning out of windows.

title: Check smoke alarms
steps: Press test button according to manufacturer's guidance
replace batteries or units as directed
caution: Never disable an alarm to stop nuisance beeps.

title: Tidy entryway
caution: Keep escape routes clear.

title: Clean reusable mop heads
caution: Never reuse toilet cleaning mop in food areas.
